title: Coast Guard Search and Rescue on a Wind Turbine
description: A rescue crew from Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City, in North Carolina, participates in a search and rescue exercise, 27-miles off the coast of Virginia, Oct. 17, 2023. During the training, the Coast Guard air crew partnered with Dominion Energy and Coast Guard Sector Virginia to lower a Coast Guard rescue swimmer onto powered-down wind turbine, rendezvoused with technicians from Dominion Energy, and simulated a rescue hoist using a liter. (U.S. Coast Guard Video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Ryan L. Noel)
keywords: Air Station, hoisting, ELIZABETH CITY, training, SAR, USCG
